name: searchFilters
label: Search filters
description: Specifies the items for tab filters. It contains the data for tab items with sysId and label

name: selectedFilters
label: Selected filter tab
description: Specifies the ID of selected filter tab, if not present all filter is selected by default

name: sortFilters
label: Sort filters
description: Specifies the items for sort filters. It contains the data for tab items with sysId and label

name: selectedSortFilters
label: Selected sort filter
description: Specifies the selected sort filter, if not present relevancy filter is selected by default

name: size
label: Size
description: Specifies if mobile or desktop variant should be rendered

name: debugView
label: Debug View
description: Displays a dropdown to specify which debug view to use
